The formula for combinations is: C(n, r) = n! / (r! × (n - r)!)

Here, n = 7 and r = 3:

C(7, 3) = 7! / (3! × 4!)

Calculate the numerator: 7! = 5040
Calculate the denominator: 3! × 4! = 6 × 24 = 144

5040 / 144 = 35

Alternatively, using the simplified form: (7 × 6 × 5) / (3 × 2 × 1) = 210 / 6 = 35

ANSWER: 35
